summary: Valens Semiconductor Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, containing its earnings release for Q1 2026. The filing reports Q1 2026 revenues of $16.9 million, gross margin of 62.2% GAAP, and a net loss of $(8.3) million, with cash and equivalents of $86.1 million. It provides Q2 2026 revenue guidance of $17.2–$17.6 million. This is a routine periodic earnings report, not a special situation. No deal terms, strategic changes, or corporate actions are described. The filing supports ongoing disclosure obligations.
